overview: This table lists the short side stories you can find in the character relationship menu.
description: Catalogue of the 45 short side stories shown in the character-relation list. A row pairs a short-story id with a localized title text id, a ScriptDataTable script id, an optional prerequisite short story, and a ShortStoryCharacterDataTable cast row; the id also drives persisted read state.

ID.simple: The name for this short story that connects it to its unlock item and saved progress.
ID.technical: FName (native `Id`; the catalog's import key). All 45 exported row keys equal this field. MainMenuStory uses it as the `StudioStoryDemoSeen_630` key, resolves the Item row whose `VariableId` equals it and tests stock >0, and copies it into the list item's `ShortStoryRowName`. That selected row name is also the key passed to `Story_GetShortStoryScriptId` and stored in `StudioStoryDiagramDemoId_CF8` when the demo phase starts. A missing save-map entry defaults to seen state 0.

Id_StoryText_Title.simple: The text shown as this short story's title in the character relationship list, already translated for your game language.
Id_StoryText_Title.technical: FName (row +0x10). An unlocked list item passes it unchanged to `SetButtonTextId(..., EApplicationLanguage::Invalid)`, which calls `SetTextIdOnly`; no parameters or string formatting are applied on this path. Locked items instead use the fixed system text `SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_1003`. Every exported `STR_STDM_SS_*` id is present in all 11 localized `StoryTextDataTable_*` exports; the separate `ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_*` family does not contain these title ids.

Id_Script.simple: Chooses the scene that plays when you open this short story, along with its background music.
Id_Script.technical: FName (row +0x18). `Story_GetShortStoryScriptId` finds the ShortStory row by id across the loaded tables in order and returns `Id_Script` without a row-null check. The short-story demo phase calls it with `StudioStoryDiagramDemoId_CF8`; `UGamePhase_StoryDemoBase::PreparePhase` then resolves the returned id in ScriptDataTables, reads `ScriptFileName` into the script player and uses `Id_Bgm` to play (or stop, when None) BGM. All 45 exported script ids resolve in ScriptDataTable with matching `ScriptFileName`.

Id_ShortStory.simple: An earlier short story you must finish first, or empty when no story is required.
Id_ShortStory.technical: FName (row +0x20; `None` when unrestricted). During MainMenuStory update, a row at seen state 1 advances to 2 only when this field is None or the linked story's `StudioStoryDemoSeen_630` value is >=3; if the linked key is absent the value stays 1. State 2 is not `Story_IsShortStoryNew` (state <=1), so the list permits selection; state >=3 is shown as already seen. The six exported links are 007->006, 009->008, 016->015, 024->023, 026->025 and 028->027; the other 39 rows are None.

Id_ShortStoryCharacter.simple: The characters shown on this story's button and needed for the matching character pair to see it in the relationship list.
Id_ShortStoryCharacter.technical: FName (row +0x28), resolved across ShortStoryCharacterDataTables (DTM +0xA40) in table order. The relation detail list and the pair 'new content' detector require a found cast row whose `Id_Character` contains both selected character ids; otherwise the story is skipped. The list item renders at most four non-None cast ids as face icons and returns early when the cast row is missing. All 45 exported ids resolve to 45 cast rows, each with four FName slots.

notes: Export scope: one ShortStoryDataTable variant with 45 rows (STDM_SS_001..045). Row keys equal Id, Id_Script equals Id, Id_StoryText_Title equals STR_<Id>, and Id_ShortStoryCharacter equals Id in every row. Every script and cast target exists and no row keys repeat.

Seen state is in the shared save map StudioStoryDemoSeen_630, not in this table: a missing key is 0, 1 means the story item is in stock but the story is not selectable yet, 2 means unlocked/unread, and 3 means read/completed. MainMenuStory only performs 0->1 through item ownership and 1->2 through the prerequisite check; finishing or skipping the short-story phase writes 3 for the current id. The UI treats <=1 as locked and >=3 as seen, the pair-new notification uses exactly 2, and the 0x100-slot save maps persist the value.

Ownership detail: Story_FindItemIdByVariableId_13022D0 scans ItemDataTables in table order for VariableId == Id, and GameItem_HasStock requires the resulting item's StudioItemStocks_590 count to be >0; InitialPossession is not consulted. All 45 exports have exactly one matching ITM_SHORT_STORY_xxx0 item with PossessionMax 1 and InitialPossession 0.

The ShortStory row has no map or BGM fields. Its script id resolves to a ScriptDataTable row that supplies Id_Bgm and Id_Map; all 45 short-story scripts set Id_Map to None, with BGM_DEMO_09 on 41 rows and BGM_DEMO_04 on 4 rows.

No ShortStoryDataTable locale variants were exported. The 45 STR_STDM_SS_* title ids do resolve in all 11 localized StoryTextDataTable_* exports, so localization is by text id rather than per-locale ShortStory rows.

Achievement caveat: UnlockStoryDemoAchievements counts every StudioStoryDemoSeen_630 entry >=3 for ACH_SHORT_STORY_01/02/ALL (thresholds 1/15/45) without filtering to ShortStory ids; the same map also holds main story demo ids.

Evidence boundary: the traced behavior comes from reconstructed C++ (with retail RVA comments) and exported data. status/ certifies some relevant retail bodies as byte matches, behavioural matches or unity-equivalent, but this page does not claim a retail byte comparison for every consuming function. Retail Blueprint assets and a live game run were not independently verified; project guidance says game logic is C++, which is not itself a Blueprint audit.

usages.detail: Loads ShortStoryDataTable through the named primary-asset loader and appends the resolved table to ShortStoryDataTables (DTM +0xA30); null tables are filtered.

Enumerates all rows once per story-menu update: creates seen state 0 at missing keys, promotes 0->1 when the VariableId item is in stock, then promotes 1->2 when Id_ShortStory is None or its linked state is >=3.
Resolves Id to the first Item row whose VariableId matches, else None, for the ownership test above.
Defines ownership as a positive saved stock count for that item id; a missing stock entry or zero count leaves seen state at 0.
Builds the relation detail short-story list; a row survives only when its cast row exists and contains both selected character ids, and its Id is stored as ShortStoryRowName.

Finds the row by the list item's row name, looks up the cast row, locks the entry for seen state <=1, shows the title only when unlocked, hides the new marker at state >=3, and draws up to four cast face icons.
Accepts a selected row name only when the entry is not locked, so state 0/1 cannot start the short-story phase.
Looks up the ShortStory row and returns Id_Script; the inline finder walks loaded tables in order and the result is dereferenced without a null check.
Supplies StudioStoryDiagramDemoId_CF8 to the script-id helper; the base phase resolves that script row for ScriptFileName and BGM.
On demo finish or skip, writes seen state 3 for the current short-story id.
Reuses Id_ShortStoryCharacter and seen state >1 && <3 to report new short-story content for a character pair.
Serializes StudioStoryDemoSeen_630 into 0x100 save slots; the matching read is at line 423.
Gates short-story achievements on a non-None short-story id and counts all map entries with seen state >=3 toward thresholds 1, 15 and 45.
